layout_notes: 1280x720. Game fills the frame. Facecam overlaps the game bottom-left (about x 0-0.33, y 0.56-1.0). Stream overlay band along the bottom (GTXPREET logo, like counter 'N / M', supporter names), QR code bottom-right, 'top supporter' widget top-right under the minimap. BGMI HUD 'Remaining N | Eliminations N' top-left at about x 0.035-0.17, y 0.005-0.04 (shows 'Players N' on the spawn island). A like-goal overlay (big green thumb + 'N / M', sometimes 'THANK YOU!') pops up over the centre of the frame, mostly on result screens but also in-game (e.g. 4078, 8745). Between matches the streamer often switches to a full-screen face/chat scene, and once (8650-8745) did so inside a match. Mode is Erangel classic squads with the 4.6 'virtual world' (Ocean Palace) feature: a blue tiled underwater area, pink/green planes flown mid-match, and a recall system: when the streamer dies the screen shows 'Don't give up! Your teammates can still recall you' / 'Spectating Teammate' and the Eliminations counter switches to the teammate's, then he comes back on a plane ('Returning to the battleground').
